origin_scheme: member + line (1-based over str.splitlines) + byte_offset/byte_length (over the extracted file bytes) + raw_sha256 of the raw line bytes

units.policy: integers pass through unchanged; O1 declares a unit only where the ported pinned reference semantics establish one, and the SMS backend pins consumption units later

declared.basis: analyze.delay_to_frames docstring (ChronoCrash animation page + legacy manual; no version-pinned trace yet)

limitations: Animation IR only: frame images are not decoded here, delay keeps the source value with the declared unit status, and no console timing decision is taken.
Attack boxes are the file's declared values only; no hit, pause/hitstop, knockdown or AI claim.
Script bodies stay text; unknown commands and unbound scripts block downstream emission and are never treated as noop.
claim_ceiling: typed IR with origin within the O1 front-end only; no emission, runtime, hit/collision, AI or conversion claim
